audit.whatIsWrong: Two places tell the player to escape the silence with Alpha Strike: spikes[1] says 'Alpha Strike out of the spin when silenced' and late says 'just Alpha Strike out whenever he silences you'. A silence denies ability casts — Alpha Strike is exactly what you cannot do while silenced. This is the worst kind of error here because the rest of the entry correctly identifies the silence as the thing that cancels the combo, and then hands the player an escape that does not exist.
audit.why: Decisive Strike is a silence on Garen's empowered next attack, and it is also an auto-attack reset — so the wind-up, not a cast animation, is the tell. Alpha Strike must be spent before the empowered auto connects, not after.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] and late rewritten: the silence locks Alpha Strike out entirely, so leap before the empowered auto lands. dosFull[1] now names the auto reset and its 8s cooldown as the trigger.
